title: Peel-and-Stick Wallpaper: The Renter-Friendly Wall Upgrade
excerpt: No commitment, no damage, all style. Peel-and-stick wallpaper is the easiest way to completely change a room's personality.

props.text: Peel-and-stick wallpaper has come a long way. The modern vinyls look like high-end designer paper, but they come off cleanly when it's time to move.
